feature-flags-api-and-sidebar-gating.description: Create API endpoints for feature_flags, then integrate into useNavigation() so sidebar hides features disabled by plan or org toggle.
steps: 1. Create GET/PATCH /api/organizations/[id]/features route for reading/toggling feature_flags.
2. Create src/hooks/use-available-features.ts that combines plan features + org feature flags + role.
3. Update hooks/use-navigation.ts to use useAvailableFeatures() to filter nav groups.
4. Update useCurrentUserRole() to also expose plan info.

feature-toggle-ui.description: Add a 'Features' section to the settings page where org owners can toggle features on/off per-plan limits.
steps: 1. Add a 'Features' section to SETTINGS_SECTIONS in _settings-sections.ts.
2. Create _feature-flags-section.tsx showing all features grouped by plan tier with toggle switches.
3. Locked features (not in current plan) show a badge 'Available on Pro' with an upgrade link.

fix-permission-action-enum.description: Add 'write' and 'invite' to permission_action enum, then backfill all existing orgs with latest permission sets by re-running seed_org_permissions() and seed_org_role_permissions() for each org.
steps: 1. Run ALTER TYPE permission_action ADD VALUE 'write' and ADD VALUE 'invite' (if not already present).
2. Create a migration that iterates all existing orgs and calls seed_org_permissions(org.id) and seed_org_role_permissions(org.id) to backfill permissions.
3. Regenerate TypeScript types and run npm run build.

permission-gating-api-routes.description: Add permission gating to all unguarded API routes by adding requiredPermission or minimumRole to createRouteHandler calls.
steps: 1. Audit all API routes in src/app/api/organizations/[id]/ that lack minimumRole/requiredPermission.
2. Add appropriate gating to each. Use these permissions where applicable:
- inventory/* (parts, movements, purchase-orders, parts-cars, suppliers, thresholds, alerts, reports): inventory.read/inventory.update
3. Seed the new permission resources into seed_org_permissions().

permission-matrix-ui.description: Build a visual permission matrix UI on the roles page that shows resources × actions with toggle checkboxes.
steps: 1. Redesign src/app/[locale]/dashboard/organization/roles/page.tsx to show a permission matrix per role.
2. Toggling a permission checkbox calls PUT /api/organizations/[id]/roles/[roleId]/permissions.
3. Add ability to create custom roles with a 'Create Role' button and dialog.
4. Add ability to edit role name/description inline or in a sheet.

plan-features-mapping.description: Create src/lib/plan-features.ts defining which feature keys each plan tier unlocks.
steps: 1. Create src/lib/plan-features.ts with a PLAN_FEATURES map: starter, pro, business, enterprise → string[] of feature flags.
2. Export helper isPlanFeatureEnabled(planType, feature) and getPlanFeatures(planType).
